summary: Stores free-form text such as GLSL source, Python callbacks, JSON, notes, or generated configuration. Useful as a stable source DAT for shader and script operators.

key_params.name: text
key_params.note: Text body stored in the DAT

key_params.name: syncfile
key_params.note: Optional file sync behavior for external source files

common_gotchas: Writing code into a Text DAT does not execute it by itself; connect or reference it from the consuming operator.
For GLSL source, validate compile state on the consuming GLSL TOP/MAT after edits.
